drawings.description: en haut à droite de la page : deux segments côte à côte, le premier étiqueté « $E_p$ » (avec une accolade), portant un gros point marqué $\alpha$, le second, épais, étiqueté « $E'_q$ » (avec une accolade) ; au-dessous, entre les deux, la mention « $E \setminus \{\alpha\}$ » précédée d'une accolade.
drawings.kind: two segments E_p and E'_q, a marked point alpha (the surjection (**))
drawings.notes: As on the page: the first segment with its end marks, the heavy point on it (computed on the segment) and the letter alpha below; the second segment, heavy, with its end marks; above each its label after a brace (E_p, E'_q); below, the brace and the legend E minus {alpha}. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au bas de la page, au milieu, quatre figures griffonnées, sans lettres. À gauche : trois points entourés d'un ovale (les deux premiers encadrés), trois autres points au-dessous entourés d'un second ovale, et trois boucles étroites obliques joignant ceux du haut à ceux du bas. À droite : deux points encadrés et un troisième à côté, le tout entouré d'un ovale ; au-dessous, deux points entourés d'un ovale. Plus bas : un segment épais à deux points marqués, dont la partie droite est encadrée.
drawings.kind: scribbled figures: marked points grouped by ovals and frames (count of fixed points)
drawings.notes: Right: a frame round two points and a third point beside it, all three inside an oval; below, two points inside an oval. Bottom: a heavy segment with two marked points, a frame round its right part (the right point is inside the frame). Left: three points in an oval, a frame round the first two; three points below in a second oval; three narrow oblique loops, each drawn here as a single stroke from the upper row to the lower row. Still differs: the left figure is scribbled over itself; the narrow loops are rendered as single strokes and which upper point each one contains is a reading (drawn: second upper point to first lower point, third upper point to second lower point, and a third stroke at the right ending at the third lower point). Not redrawn: the zigzag pen trial lower on the page (no content). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

figures.what: two rows of three points joined by loops

drawings.description: en marge gauche, un dessin : un cercle coupé en deux arcs $A$ (à gauche) et $B$ (à droite) par deux points marqués $a$ (en bas) et $b$ (en haut), et le cône de sommet $o$ tracé sur ce cercle : deux génératrices tangentes au contour et les deux génératrices $oa$ et $ob$.
drawings.kind: circle cut into two arcs A, B by two points, and the cone of vertex o over it
drawings.notes: The circle (an ellipse fitted to his outline) with the two marked points on it, b at the top and a at the bottom, the letters A and B beside the left and right arcs; the vertex o below at the left; four lines from o, all drawn from the one vertex: the two outer ones touching the outline at the left and at the lower right, the generator to a, and the generator to b, which crosses the disc. Still differs: on the page the generator o-b is visible mainly inside the disc and the generator o-a is broken (dashed) below the circle; both are drawn as full lines. The small letters beside the two points are barely legible: read b (top) and a (bottom) after the note of the transcription. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: marge gauche, en bas, pris dans les lignes écrites en diagonale : un petit croquis à main levée --- un gros point traversé d'un trait épais, d'où partent vers la droite deux traits courbes fins finissant en flèche devant « $R_{ij}$ » ; au-dessous à droite, une seconde tache d'où une flèche remonte vers le gros point, avec « $X_i$ » dessous.
drawings.kind: small free-hand sketch among diagonal writing: a marked point with arrows, labels R_ij, X_i
drawings.notes: A heavy point with a short heavy stroke across it and a thin stroke to its left; two thin curved strokes from the point to the right, ending in an arrowhead before the label R_ij; a second heavy blot below at the right, and an arrow coming up to the first point from the lower right, with the label X_i under it (the transcription reads X_i^* among the labels of this sketch). Decided here, on the page: the three long wavy oblique strokes that run through the place are lines of the marginal NB written in diagonal (his fast hand reduces words to wavy strokes; each ends in a legible word or symbol), not parts of the sketch; they are left out, with the rest of the writing. Left out as well: two small letters beside the heavy point (not read). Still differs: the sketch cannot be separated with certainty from the handwriting that crosses it. The label C_ij named by the note of the transcription was not found in the sketch (the word « cylindre » stands at its right). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
